task: Apply the validated VX engineStyle color-token state as local CSS custom properties on the already-rendered shared engine root, preserving inherited Template DNA for omitted tokens and changing no engine business behavior.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Local CSS-variable scoping touches the canonical renderer path, so it requires runtime parity, inheritance and sibling-isolation proof; business authorities remain unchanged.

deferredTechniques.reason: No transactional or concurrent protocol changes.

acceptanceCriteria: A valid engineStyle object applies semantic color CSS variables only to that engine's rendered root.
No engineStyle or an empty state produces byte-for-behavior equivalent inherited Template DNA with no local variable reset.
Partial overrides leave omitted colors inherited.
The runtime does not introduce a wrapper element that changes grid/layout semantics.
Malformed engineStyle fails closed during render instead of silently accepting unsafe data.
The renderer remains one canonical StorefrontRuntimeRenderer and all engine business decorators remain unchanged.
invariants: Local style never mutates Page documents or global style state.
Sibling engine overrides cannot leak into one another.
Rendering order and business decorators remain canonical.
No raw CSS property names are accepted.

alternatives.summary: Wrap every engine in a styled div.
alternatives.reason: Can alter grid/layout semantics and DOM.

alternatives.summary: Clone the already-rendered root and merge only validated CSS variables into its style.
alternatives.reason: Preserves DOM structure and scopes inheritance locally.

alternatives.summary: Mutate global page design tokens for each engine.
alternatives.reason: Would leak across siblings and destroy Template DNA authority.

specialistReviews.resolution: Add one post-render presentation decorator in the existing renderer only.

specialistReviews.finding: A wrapper or style replacement could alter layout.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use React cloneElement with merged style and no wrapper; no-op on absent style.

specialistReviews.finding: Runtime must trust only the validated semantic parser.
Template inheritance must remain visible until user overrides a token.
specialistReviews.resolution: Only explicit variables are written locally.

challenge.finding: Local decorator could reset inherited colors.
challenge.resolution: Return rendered node unchanged when no variables resolve.

challenge.finding: Other colors might be replaced with defaults.
challenge.resolution: Merge only the accent CSS variable; all others inherit.

challenge.scenario: Rendered engine root already has inline style.
challenge.finding: Override application could erase layout styles.
challenge.resolution: Merge CSS variables after preserving existing style object.

challenge.scenario: Two adjacent engines use different accents.
challenge.finding: Variables could leak if attached to page/global root.
challenge.resolution: Attach variables to each concrete rendered root only.

challenge.finding: Unsafe state could be ignored inconsistently.
challenge.resolution: Validated resolver throws and canonical renderer fails closed.
Only apply when isValidElement and resolved variables are non-empty; engine roots in adopted families are validated in tests.

challenge.finding: Editor overlays could receive styling instead of runtime root.
challenge.resolution: Engine styling occurs before external decorateNode.

challenge.scenario: Existing commerce decorator replaces the raw renderer.
challenge.finding: Style must target final engine UI.
challenge.resolution: Apply engine style after decorateExistingCommerce and before interaction/decorateNode.

proofPlan: Run Plan Before Code on stacked diff.
Add static/runtime markup tests for inherited/partial/sibling styles.
Run incremental replay, quality tests, typecheck and production build.
Keep exact DOM structure and one renderer authority.
No main merge or golden update.

requirements.requirement: Scope validated engine colors to each rendered engine root without wrappers.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No wrapper, global token mutation or second renderer.

requirements.requirement: Preserve Template DNA inheritance and sibling isolation for absent/partial overrides.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Omitted engine tokens cannot be replaced by local defaults.

requirements.requirement: Fail closed on malformed engineStyle while preserving all business engine behavior.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Style handling cannot alter capability, bindings, pricing, stock, cart or checkout.

notes: Stacked runtime-only slice on PR #578. Builder UI controls and Blank Studio are intentionally excluded.
